product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides an AI-native operating system for banks that replaces legacy core infrastructure and enables custom AI agents to automate operations and deliver financial products.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or public plan listing was found; the site directs visitors to request access.

named_customers.notes: Fewer than two qualifying customer names were found. The /clients page shows investor backers, and Emprise Bank is described as a design partner.

employee_band.notes: The public company profile reports 11 employees.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook lists 2025, consistent with the founder's January 2025 start date; the LinkedIn company profile instead lists 2026.

eng_blog.notes: No actual blog was found: /blog displays the homepage, while the newsroom lists press coverage.

public_docs.notes: The public navigation and footer contain no documentation, help-center or developer-portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The board lists three roles: Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer and Senior Staff Software Engineer; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No named model or provider was disclosed in the reviewed product material, privacy policy, announcements or technical job postings. No public documentation, AI FAQ or named subprocessor list was found.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy names none of the five specified certifications or compliance frameworks.

last_funding.notes: The date is the announcement month: August 3, 2026. Emprise's October 2026 announcement says the round closed in late 2025; the exact closing month is not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The $30 million seed round was announced in August 2026 and reportedly closed in late 2025; both dates fall within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: All three listed openings are software-engineering roles; no SDR, BDR or account-executive role is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: On August 3, 2026, Maximum publicly introduced its bank operating system as it emerged from stealth; this does not establish general availability.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: COO Andrew Dust and CRO Alex Steiner list August 2026 start dates at Maximum.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The three readable job postings name no CRM or sales-and-marketing platform.
